subject.title: [Mac App] node.invoke system.run causes WebSocket disconnection on macOS

question: Should maintainers require signed macOS live reproduction before authorizing a repair lane for this `system.run` disconnect?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the path and the reported gateway error shape, but the failure could originate in several macOS/Gateway layers and the repo already marks this issue as needing live repro.

options.title: Run signed macOS repro first
options.body: Use a current-main signed macOS app and gateway logs to identify the failing layer before queuing a fix.

options.title: Ask reporter for diagnostics
options.body: Request current-release app Console logs and gateway logs if maintainers cannot run the signed macOS scenario soon.

options.title: Authorize speculative repair
options.body: Allow a narrow repair attempt against the most plausible layer, accepting the risk that it may not address the real disconnect trigger.

recommendation.title: Run signed macOS repro first
recommendation.body: Use a current-main signed macOS app and gateway logs to identify the failing layer before queuing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged macOS bridge/ShellExecutor stabilization history is closest to the command-execution side of this issue.
